universe: Frozen 469 current Stock Connect stocks above HKD10bn from 2026-09-06; 461 multi-bar histories, 5 price errors and 3 single-bar records remain visible
selection: Develop on 2019-2023, diagnose 2016-2018; lock finalists before examining 2024-2026. Earlier conversation already examined full-history strategies: reserved validation is a new-loop holdout, not a never-seen independent sample.

objectives.majority: strictly positive paired net CAGR difference on >50% of eligible stocks; ties are not wins
objectives.cagr_aspiration: median per-stock full-calendar net CAGR >=8%, not annualized only over invested days
objectives.sharpe: maximize median daily Sharpe, cash rate zero; also compare paired Sharpe versus Buy & Hold
objectives.activity: at least 80% of selection-cohort stocks have an entry; report all-cash cases and do not award them a finite Sharpe
objectives.normalization: cross-candidate average-rank percentiles over all completed development candidates; higher is better; activity-ineligible candidates remain visible but cannot be finalists

execution.side: long only, unlevered, fractional adjusted shares
execution.signal: observed daily close using only that date and earlier inputs
execution.fill: next positive-volume observed open; later target change replaces pending order
execution.terminal: liquidate at last observed close if positive volume; otherwise mark open position and disclose
execution.warmup: indicators may use prior dates before evaluation window; each window starts with cash and can first signal on its first observed close
execution.benchmark: Buy & Hold on the identical stock, window, prices, costs and next-open convention

coverage: All valid multi-bar stocks are evaluated. Primary full-history statistics require >=3 years, >=95% reference-calendar coverage and an end within 7 days of the window end. Development/training require >=2 years. Full-ten-year 275-stock subset reported separately; no invented pre-IPO history.
final_checks: one extra observed bar execution delay
time-block bootstrap for equal-account portfolio, not independent-stock significance
fundamentals: Only lagged published/assumed-available fields; snapshot GAAP proxies labeled exploratory, no replacement of missing records with future values. Missing-data fallback must be explicit per candidate.
archive: Commit each coherent source/spec change and each completed iteration's results/diagnosis to master, push without force. Track small per-stock metrics, config, input SHA256 manifest and source commit; large curves remain ignored locally.
biases: current-universe survivorship and current market-cap filtering
multiple testing across all attempted candidates
earlier experiments have inspected this historical market
adjusted synthetic prices and proportional costs approximate real trading
